zmiany: New Auto tab: captions for the whole transcript in one style, with a Layouts step to fine-tune every caption
Layouts: move, resize and restyle words (Standard / Style look), move selected words to the next or previous caption
Auto keeps your title's animation and only links the directions between captions
Upper words start 4 frames earlier so the animation has time to play; very short captions are extended
Preview shows the real look: colors, gradients, glow, blur and shadow
Template 1/2/3: click = layout only, Shift-click = layout with animation
Words in a row are spaced like a normal space
Punctuation is removed when titles are created from a transcript
New built-in styles EM BOLD, EM BOLD YELLOW and EM BOUNCY, with the Kanit font family
